name: Arjac Rockfist
unitComposition:
• 1 Arjac Rockfist model

This model is equipped with: 1 Foehammer.

abilities.lore: There are many ways by which to deploy troops to the field of battle including tunnels, teleportation devices and other esoteric means of transportation.
abilities.name: Deep Strike
abilities.rules: Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

abilities.name: Anvil of Endurance
abilities.rules:
In the Fight phase, when a model in this unit is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is then removed from the battlefield.

abilities.lore: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.
abilities.name: Leader
abilities.rules: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it. See Attached Units (19)

abilities.name: Champion of the Kingsguard
abilities.rules:
This model’s attacks that target a Character unit:
  • Can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

rules.name: Leader
rules.rules:
This model can be attached to the following units:

■ **TERMINATOR ASSAULT SQUAD**
■ **TERMINATOR SQUAD**
■ **WOLF GUARD TERMINATORS**

abilities.name: ANTI-MONSTER/VEHICLE 3+
abilities.rules: This ability always takes the form [ANTI‑X Y+]. Each time an attack is made with an [ANTI] weapon, if the target unit has the keyword denoted by X, an unmodified wound roll of Y+ is a critical wound. Example: An attack made with an [ANTI‑VEHICLE 4+] weapon against a VEHICLE unit will result in a critical wound on an unmodified wound roll of 4+, while an attack made with an [ANTI‑PSYKER 2+] weapon against a PSYKER unit will result in a critical wound on an unmodified wound roll of 2+.

abilities.name: ASSAULT
abilities.rules: Units containing one or more models with an [ASSAULT] weapon can shoot using assault shooting (10.05).

abilities.name: PRECISION
abilities.rules: While resolving attacks made with one or more [PRECISION] weapons, at the start of the Allocation Order step (05.03), if the target unit contains one or more CHARACTER models visible to one or more of the attacking models, the active player can select one allocation group that contains one of those visible CHARACTER models. If they do, until those attacks are resolved, or until that CHARACTER group is destroyed (whichever happens first), that CHARACTER group is the current allocation group.
